function.description: Read and change your typed preferences (approvals, budget caps, goal quotas, digest/delivery, reply style, session defaults). operation='list' shows every preference (value/source/applies); 'get' with `key` shows one; 'explain' with `key` shows the provenance chain of ANY setting (preference or env flag) — use it to answer 'why is X off?'. 'set' with `key`+`value`: a SAFE key applies from your next step unless the result says next session; a GUARDED key (budget/approval ceiling) only queues a proposal for the owner (/pending).
function.name: preferences

key.description: Setting key (e.g. 'style.verbosity'); explain also takes an env flag (e.g. 'TWITTER_ENABLED')

reason.description: set only: one sentence for the owner — why this change (shown when a guarded key waits for review)

value.description: set only: new value (coerced per the key's type)
